purpose: Minimal train-only package for testing whether a reduced magnetic surface-transport model reconstructs deliberately hidden transient map gaps better than last-map persistence.

geometry.rotation_degrees_per_day: finite signed rate appropriate to the declared map coordinates
geometry.validated_horizon_hours: positive finite horizon used only for the uncertainty proxy

npz_required_arrays.roles: string [rows]; artificial holdouts are allowed only where role == score

physics_model.plain_language: Move the last real magnetic map sideways according to the declared solar-map rotation rate and let the magnetic pattern spread slightly.
physics_model.equation_family: 2-D advection plus diffusion on the declared regular map grid

admission_rule: Better hidden-map pixel error is necessary but not sufficient. Physics may enter the SEP forecast experiment only after a causal map-to-feature path exists and downstream forecast preservation is evaluated against simpler recovery methods.
claim_boundary: This package contract does not establish accurate solar simulation, downstream SEP benefit, operational readiness, superiority, savings, breakthrough or award outcome.
